title: Target anatomy
view: The right midface of the skull from the front: head at the top, the patient's right on the image left.
teachingPoint: The foramen sits about 1 cm below the orbital rim on the pupil line; from the mucobuccal fold above the first premolar the needle runs up toward it about 1.5-2 cm and stops short of it.
claims: Right maxilla from the front, patient's right on the image left (house laterality).
Infraorbital foramen about 1 cm below the inferior orbital rim, on the pupil line (record, subtitle).
Needle entry in the mucobuccal fold above the first premolar (record, steps 5); the tip stops 18 mm in, short of the foramen (record: roughly 1.5-2 cm, stop before the foramen).
Yellow: the infraorbital nerve's branches fanning from the foramen to the lower eyelid, nose and upper lip (standard anatomy, added).
Three labels: Infraorbital foramen, Orbital rim, First premolar.

geometry.why: foramen is below the orbital rim
foramen is on the pupil line
foramen is lateral to the nose (patient's right is left)
entry is in the fold below the foramen
the needle stops short of the foramen
needle stays lateral to the nose
entry is above the first premolar
